visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An animated male character with messy black hair, glasses, and a blue button-down shirt holds a brown cardboard box. He has a smug, closed-mouth smile and closed eyes, conveying confidence. The background is a simple split of yellow and white. A speech bubble is visible. (2) Cut to a two-shot of the man with glasses and another animated male with black hair wearing a red t-shirt. The man in the red shirt looks skeptical with crossed arms. The man with glasses gestures with his hands, pointing at the box and later showing three fingers, maintaining his boastful expression. (3) Close-up on the man with glasses, who has a mischievous grin with his tongue sticking out. He begins to handle the box as if opening it. (4) The man with glasses is now looking down at the box, his expression shifting to confusion and concern. He pulls out two small figurines or bottles featuring cartoon witches. A large white ring appears over the scene as a visual highlight. (5) A close-up shot focuses on a purple box labeled 'S WITCH 2'. A hand enters the frame, pointing specifically at the space between the 'S' and the 'WITCH'. (6) The man with glasses is shown sweating and looking horrified, holding the two witch figurines. Lines of distress are drawn on his face. (7) The character screams at the camera, his face visually 'shattering' like glass. The background is a vibrant, animated rainbow. (8) In the final scene, the man with glasses is slumped over and grayed out, while the man in the red shirt stands next to him, looking on with a smirk.

(2) [Subtitle]: through some... special connections online. [Subtitle]: 跟網路上的人預購的SWITCH2. (3) [Subtitle]: Back then, the first 10 people to order even got a 20% discount! [Subtitle]: 那時候下單前10位還有8折優惠呢. (4) [Subtitle]: Jealous, huh? [Subtitle]: 羨慕吧~. (5) [Subtitle]: You won't even be able to buy one until after July! [Subtitle]: 你要7月以後才買的到呢~. (6) [Subtitle]: You actually bought it from one of those sketchy sites...? [Subtitle]: 你居然從那種奇怪的地方購買... (7) [Subtitle]: You are so bold... [Subtitle]: 我也是服了你... (8) [Subtitle]: Come on, you're just jealous, admit it! [Subtitle]: 我看你只是在羨慕而已吧~. (9) [Subtitle]: Let me unbox it for you right now— [Subtitle]: 我現在就拆給你看. (10) [Subtitle]: Wait... huh? It does say SWITCH 2 on the box... [Subtitle]: 欸?奇怪...上面有寫SWITCH2啊. (11) [Subtitle]: But... doesn't the box look kinda... off? [Subtitle]: 但盒子怎麼長得不太一樣? (12) [Subtitle]: Hold up... between the S and the W... [Subtitle]: 等一下 IS跟W中間. [Variety]: S WITCH 2. (13) [Subtitle]: is that... a tiny space? [Subtitle]: 好像有個微小的空格. (14) [Subtitle]: Wait a second... this is actually... [Subtitle]: 所以這其實是... (15) [Variety]: S WITCH 2. (16) [Subtitle]: Two size-S witches?!? [Subtitle]: S號的巫婆兩隻!??. (17) [Subtitle]: I GOT SCAMMED!!! visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One character has black hair and glasses, wearing a blue button-down shirt; the other has black hair and wears a maroon/red t-shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Minimalist animated background with solid colors (white, yellow, blue) and simple indoor-style shading. Some scenes use high-energy effects like rainbow stripes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, enthusiastic male voice speaks with rapid-fire delivery and an exaggerated smug tone. Underneath, a light, plucky BGM featuring piano and subtle percussion plays at a moderate tempo. (2) A clear 'paper rustle' sound effect accompanies the vocal shift as the speaker boasts. The BGM continues its cheerful, steady rhythm. (3) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition. A second, slightly deeper male voice enters with a skeptical, flat intonation. (4) A loud 'click' or 'thud' sound occurs as a package is opened. The first voice becomes hesitant, pitch rising in confusion. (5) The BGM abruptly stops for a split second of strategic silence. Then, a dramatic comedic stinger SFX (riser) sounds as the second voice points out a detail. (6) The first speaker erupts into an extremely loud, high-arousal scream. The BGM shifts to a frantic, circus-like fast tempo with heavy synthesizer accents. (7) A 'glass shattering' sound effect plays at the peak of the scream. (8) The audio ends with a soft, ironic melodic phrase on the piano as the first voice groans in defeat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Conflict -> Reveal -> Climax -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To deliver a humorous punchline about a consumer's misfortune when trying to buy a highly anticipated tech product (Nintendo Switch 2) through non-official, 'shady' channels, ultimately revealing the 'Switch' was actually 'S size Witches'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: This is a social media-style animation with high audio-visual synchronization, using classic cartoon tropes and sound effects to enhance the comedic timing of the 'scam' reveal.
